name: Witch Hunter: Shadow Trap cannot be attacked by hostile players (#9947)
contract: Shadow Trap 680238 reads 'Place a dark trap on the ground lasting $d that will curse the first enemy to
approach it'. Like native hunter traps it is a ground object, not a combatant: the field entity 506250 it
summons is only the trap's carrier and must never be a valid attack target. With the Orc Witch Hunter and
an ungrouped Human player both PvP-flagged, Caltrops 503679 summons (creature 506010, attackable by
hostile players per #4968) show that the hostile player can attack the Witch Hunter's ordinary field
summons, while the Shadow Trap carrier placed out of trigger range must not be attackable through native
IsValidAttackTarget. The trap must stay armed and owned.

steps.label: CONTROL: the hostile player can attack ordinary field summons
DISCRIMINATING: the hostile player cannot attack the Shadow Trap
